sv.title: Anthropic rasar – S&P 500 faller för sjunde dagen i rad
sv.summary: USA-börserna var på ett fortsatt uselt humör i fredagens inledande handel. AI-jätten Anthropic fick en smakstart på karriären som noterat på bolag, men på fredagen var det andra bollar och aktien rasar i den inledande handeln.

en.title: Anthropic plunges – S&P 500 falls for seventh day in a row
en.summary: US exchanges were in a continued dismal mood in Friday's opening trade. AI giant Anthropic got a rocky start to its career as a listed company, but on Friday it was a different story, and the share is plunging in early trading.
